summary_1line: Bhishma explains the four Brahmanical life stages—Brahmacharya, Garhastha, Vanaprastha, and Bhaikshya—and their duties, emphasizing sacrifice, discipline, hospitality, and pursuit of spiritual liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: A grey-haired Brahmana with matted locks leaves his home and walks into a quiet forest, carrying sacred fire implements while his wife watches silently.
A wandering mendicant Brahmana sleeps beneath a tree at dusk, holding a begging bowl after receiving alms from villagers.
A humble student smeared with clay bows before his seated guru while reciting Vedic mantras beside a small ritual fire.
